about.title: Cinematic Storytelling Born in Pakistan
about.story: Founded with an obsessive dedication to visual mastery, Shifa Productions is a full-spectrum film and visual arts production house based in Lahore and Islamabad. We engineer compelling narrative films, regal wedding cinema, high-impact commercials, and dynamic short-form content with state-of-the-art cinema equipment and seasoned industry veterans.
about.cinematicVision: We believe every frame should evoke emotion, command attention, and honor the essence of our clients’ stories. From heritage haveli celebrations to multinational television commercials, our work is defined by precision, grandeur, and cinematic intimacy.

faqs.question: Which cities across Pakistan do you cover?
faqs.answer: While our primary production offices and studio facilities are in Lahore (Gulberg III) and Islamabad (F-7), we regularly travel and deploy full cinema crews nationwide, including Karachi, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, and northern destinations (Hunza, Skardu). Travel and logistics are transparently itemized.

faqs.question: What is your payment and booking deposit structure?
faqs.answer: To reserve your production date on our calendar, we require a 50% advance booking deposit in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) via official bank transfer. 30% is due on the primary shoot date, and the remaining 20% balance is settled upon delivery of the final master approval.

faqs.question: How long does post-production and editing take?
faqs.answer: For wedding cinema and commercial films, our clients receive an initial vertical social media teaser within 72 hours to 7 days. Full documentary and signature highlight films are meticulously color-graded and delivered within 3 to 5 weeks.

faqs.question: What cinema equipment and camera systems do you operate?
faqs.answer: We own and deploy tier-one cinema ecosystems: ARRI Alexa Mini LF, RED V-Raptor 8K, Sony FX6 / FX3 cinema line, Master Anamorphic and Cooke prime lenses, DJI Inspire 3 8K drones, Aputure / Nanlite gaffer lighting, and professional wireless Sennheiser / Sound Devices audio.

faqs.question: Do you obtain drone flight clearances in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our drone pilots are certified and we handle necessary civil aviation and regional security permissions for commercial and wedding drone operations across Pakistani cities.
